# Mandola’s Italian Kitchen

> Italian Kitchen in Oldsmar, Florida. Pizza from hand-stretched dough, chicken parmesan, fresh focaccia on the table and a gelato counter, with party trays and catering for the whole crowd.

- Offers: Pizza, hand-stretched; Chicken parmesan and pasta; Gelato counter
